current.custom_script_for_head:
<style>
.product-price {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
    color: #D4AF37 !important;
    margin: 0 !important;
}

/* Price elements - comprehensive selectors */
.price,
.price__regular,
.price__sale,
.price-item,
.price-item--regular,
.price-item--sale {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* Ensure price containers maintain styling */
[data-price],
[data-price-regular],
[data-price-sale] {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* Target price elements within product section */
.product-section .price,
.product-section .price__regular,
.product-section .price__sale,
.product-section .price-item,
.product-section .price-item--regular,
.product-section .price-item--sale {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* Target price in main product area */
.main-product .price,
.main-product .price__regular,
.main-product .price__sale,
.main-product .price-item,
.main-product .price-item--regular,
.main-product .price-item--sale {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* Variant-related price elements */
.variant-price,
.variant-price__regular,
.variant-price__sale {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* Price elements that might be dynamically updated */
.price-container,
.price-container .price,
.price-container .price__regular,
.price-container .price__sale {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}

/* Ensure inline price elements maintain styling */
span[class*="price"],
div[class*="price"] {
    font-size: 2.5rem !important;
    font-weight: 700 !important;
}
</style>
